pages.text: A photon absorbed breaks one bond; what follows can make several molecules of product - the quantum yield Φ. How much of the light is absorbed is the $(thing)Beer-Lambert law$(): the absorbance is A = εcl, and the cell takes a fraction 1 − 10^(−A).

The $(item)Photochemical Reactor$() (a console) makes Titan's own haze chemistry: $(item)Tholin$() and $(fluid)Hydrogen Cyanide$() from methane and nitrogen, and $(fluid)Hydrogen$() from water. Set the path length so the mixture absorbs 90% to 99.9% of the light (A between 1 and 3): thinner and the light goes through, thicker and only a skin by the window reacts. Brighter is faster, up to 400 W/m².
